verification.confirmation_rule: confirmed only when the upgraded proof carries a BitcoinBlockHeaderAttestation

what_this_establishes: The canonical checkpoint preimage hashes exactly to the published checkpoint tip, and the upgraded OpenTimestamps proof carries a Bitcoin block attestation.
what_this_does_not_establish: This timestamp does not independently prove the truth of the MIR event behind the checkpoint. It externally timestamps Public Contract's committed checkpoint evidence.
